messages:
jia: Quick note: ran equinox-v1 (quant=q5k) onboarding smoke against multilang.simple_translation. Seeing weird bracket/paren flipping in zh-HK and ar-MA outputs, plus a handful of mirrored punctuation in mixed RTL/LTR lines. Posting a few inline samples.

omar: can you paste the eval command and one minimal example?

jia: command:
```
./ci/eval_smoke.sh --model equinox-v1 --quant q5k --locales zh-HK,ar-MA,zh-TW --suite multilang.simple_translation --out /tmp/equinox_q5k_smoke.jsonl
```

jia: sample 1 (zh-HK):
- src: "會議定於 6/10 (週四) 開始"
- ref: "Meeting starts 6/10 (Thu)"
- equinox-q5k: "Meeting starts 6/10 \uff09Thu\uff08"  <-- parentheses mirrored and order odd

kevin: sample 2 (ar-MA):
- src: "(تاريخ) 10/6"
- ref: "(Date) 10/6"
- equinox-q5k: "(تاريخ] 10/6"  <-- closing bracket changed to ']'

talia: ugh. sounds like a detok normalization or a unicode category mapping issue in the kernel. Any token dumps?

jia: token dumps (pre-infer tokenizer):
```
# zh tokens: ["會議","定於"," ","6","/","10"," ","(","週","四",")"," ","開始"]
# post-infer detok stream: ["會議","定於"," ","6","/","10"," ","\uff09","週","四","\uff08"," ","開始"]
```

omar: that looks like mirrored glyphs substituted for parens. Which kernel pack did q5k get compiled with?

jia: build metadata: equinox-v1-q5k-kernelpack: kernel_pack_2025-11-05-7c8a. q8 baseline uses kernel_pack_2025-10-29-4d2b.

Build-bot: /build meta model=equinox-v1 variant=q5k kernel=kernel_pack_2025-11-05-7c8a

omar: grep shows a recent change in kernel/unicode_map.c where MIRROR_TABLE entries were extended. Could be that q5k build linked a different normalize path.

kevin: try comparing raw token streams from q8 and q5k before detok. If identical, detok step is the culprit. If different, tokenmap/kernels differ.

jia: quick diff: pre-detok token streams are IDENTICAL across q8 and q5k for these samples. So detok or post-normalization likely.

L10n-bot: /report locale_issue model=equinox-v1 quant=q5k suite=multilang.simple_translation delta_bleu_zhHK=-0.18 delta_bleu_arMA=-0.52 samples=600

talia: assign to eng-runtime + tokenization. @omar please take runtime side, @kevin tokenization/detok?

omar: will bisect kernel pack changes between 4d2b and 7c8a. running a minimized detok harness to reproduce.

kevin: I'll run the detokenizer locally with both normalization configs. quick test: run `python -c "from detok import Detok; print(Detok.normalize('\u0028') )"` to see mapping of '(' -> maybe mirrored.

jia: mitigation: temporary routing to q8 variant for locales zh-HK and ar-MA. snippet we applied in console:
```json
{"routes": {"locale_overrides": {"zh-HK": "equinox-v1-q8", "ar-MA": "equinox-v1-q8"}}}
```

omar: bisect update: narrowed to commit range where unicode mirror handling was refactored (commit a9f2 -> b13e). The refactor introduced a fallback that reorders mirror pairing under certain normalization flags. q5k build seems to flip the flag.

kevin: patch suggestion: align q5k detok config with q8 by forcing unicode_mirror=false in the detok config at build-time. Quick PR against release/quant-packs.

jia: created ticket ML-ONBOARD-412 and added sample artifacts + token dumps + detok logs.

L10n-bot: Noted: add more locales to smoke (fa,he) to check RTL scope.

omar: if fixing build is non-trivial, we'll keep routing override for the affected locales and schedule a hotfix build. prioritizing since customer-facing translations could be impacted.

kevin: one more weirdness: a handful of samples show mirrored glyphs only when punctuation is adjacent to ascii weekday tokens (e.g., "Thu"), suggests mixed-script interaction in the detok bidi step.

jia: thanks all. keeping this thread for live bisect logs. will post PR link and hotfix ETA when available. :hourglass_flowing_sand:
